Implemented the fix.

- Explicit function template specializations now record a dependency on their primary template declaration, preventing IWYU from removing the required header.
- Added a regression test covering a deleted explicit specialization in an associated header.
- Verified fixture compilation under C++11, formatting, license headers, test registration, and `git diff --check`.

The full IWYU test wasn’t run because no built `include-what-you-use` executable is available in the workspace.
